text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P1 — Elevated errors for tenant 'marigold' on dedicated pool marigold-prod-us-east. Symptom: bulk mTLS handshake failures at auth-bridge -> downstream 502/503. Impact: customer traffic 100% failing, active sessions dropping. Paging oncall-sre and platform.
samantha (oncall): I'm awake and looking. @raj @jordan can you join? marigold-prod us-east is spiking 5xx across the auth-bridge and edge.
jordan (sre): I'll grab logs now. Quick heads-up from tcpdump: a bunch of TLS alerts 'certificate expired' coming from marigold's client certs. Log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T03:12:11Z auth-bridge ERROR tls: handshake error: tls: certificate has expired (CN=marigold-client-1)
2026-03-15T03:12:12Z auth-bridge WARN token-introspect 401 invalid_client jwks-lookup failed: 404
```
jordan (sre): Also seeing token introspection returning 401 when hitting our internal JWKS proxy — likely client cert not present or cert chain rejected.
raj (platform eng): Marigold is a dedicated VPC with mTLS enforced. If their client cert expired and they rotated it on their side but didn't upload the new cert to our keystore, auth will fail. Can we do a quick routing bypass to allow bearer-token fallback for that tenant while we get cert from them?
samantha (oncall): Good idea. Implementing a temporary routing override to route marigold traffic to hosted-auth-fallback (token-based) for the next 60m. Applying to 4 edge nodes now.
ops-automation-bot: Routing override applied: tenant=marigold -> hosted-auth-fallback (3/4 nodes successful, 1 retry left).
marigold-ops: We're seeing 503s in our app, confirmed on our side the cert rotation happened but the new cert wasn't propagated to your keystore. We uploaded to our carrier but didn't push to Redwood keystore (we assumed auto-sync).
maria (acct exec): I'm on the call with the Marigold SREs. They've just pushed the cert to their artifact store; asked what we need to do on our side.
kevin (platform eng): We need their client cert chain (PEM) - thumbprint verification. Two options:
1) They upload to our secure bucket (s3://redwood-keystore/uploads/marigold/) and we import.
2) We accept a signed one-time thumbprint and rotate keystore via API.
jordan (sre): I'm going to restart the auth-bridge pods for marigold after import. Command I'll run:
```
kubectl -n redwood-marigold rollout restart deployment/auth-bridge --context=cluster-us-east-1
```
samantha (oncall): I'll coordinate the keystore import with kevin. kevin — can you prepare an import job and mark it as urgent? I'll keep the routing override active until we validate.
kevin (platform eng): Import job ready. marigold-ops please upload PEM to s3://redwood-keystore/uploads/marigold/ and DM me the S3 path. Once uploaded I'll validate the chain and run the import.
marigold-ops: Uploaded as s3://redwood-keystore/uploads/marigold/marigold-client-2026-03-15.pem. Thumbprint: 3f:aa:7c:1b:9e:24:db:... DM sent.
ops-automation-bot: Keystore import job started for tenant marigold. JobID=kj-202603150312. Progress: validating chain...
kevin (platform eng): Validation ok (chain and EKU OK). Importing to keystore now.
ops-automation-bot: Keystore import complete. Applying keystore update to auth-bridge nodes (4/4 nodes queued).
jordan (sre): Performing rolling restart of auth-bridge now to pick up new cert.
ops-automation-bot: kubectl rollout restart succeeded for deployment/auth-bridge (marigold namespace) on node set us-east-1a/b/c.
jordan (sre): Post-restart: initial sampling shows mTLS handshakes succeeding, 200s returning for token-introspect. Rolling 5xx rate down to baseline.
samantha (oncall): Removing temporary routing override in 2 minutes. Monitoring for errors and request latency.
ops-automation-bot: Routing override removed (all nodes). Live metrics: 5xx reduced from 98% -> 1.2% over 6 minutes. Error budget impact: high but mitigated.
maria (acct exec): Shared update with Marigold leadership: "We applied a temporary token-fallback and imported your rotated client cert. Auth traffic is healthy. We'll revert fallback and monitor." They want a postmortem and ask for RCA timeline.
raj (platform eng): Action items for follow-up (adding to ticket):
- Add keystore upload step to customer rotation checklist and add automation to poll customer artifact store for new certs.
- Improve monitoring alerts to include explicit 'client cert expired' fingerprint alerts.
- Add a transient allowlist feature in routing for managed fallbacks (with audit/TTL).
samantha (oncall): Handing off monitoring and postmortem writeup to jordan for the next 2 hours. If anything regresses paging will escalate to platform lead. Jordan — you're owner for the follow-up ticket.
jordan (sre): Taking it. I'll file INC-20260315-1843 and draft a short customer-facing RCA. Will include timeline, root cause (customer cert rotation not pushed to Redwood keystore), and the mitigations we executed.
marigold-ops: Thanks team — service looks stable from our side. Please send the RCA to our security contact and cc our platform team.
samantha (oncall): Thanks everyone. Closing the active pager. Will leave the ticket open for RCA and automation work. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Pager cleared by samantha at 2026-03-15T03:23:32Z. Severity: P1 -> mitigated. Handoff: jordan (sre) now incident lead for postmortem.
